notes: No case ending, possessive, plural mark, -val/-vel style suffix or hyphen suffix is attached to a placeholder or #; i18n:check fails on them. Placeholders go after a colon or before a carrier noun ({name} bázisa, {n} harcos, {arg1} múlva).
No a/az article directly before a placeholder: the choice depends on the next sound, which the game cannot know.
Numerals take the singular noun in Hungarian, so the one and other plural branches have the same shape.

Generated names use the default setting (first part, space, second part): Hungarian puts an uninflected adjective before the noun, e.g. Mennydörgő Csúcs, Ködös Völgy, Kettős Penge. generatedNames can stay unset.

Hungarian uses ő ű Ő Ű, which are outside the bundled Latin-1 fonts: activating hu needs the SYSTEM_FONT_LANGS / styles.css integration step (tests/locales/latin-fonts.test.ts fails for hu until then), like ro and vi.

Japan statutory pages (tokushoho, shikin-kessai) are translated fully into Hungarian, with the English sub-lines dropped as vi does; the support page links them by their Japanese titles. The translation is not a lawyer’s review.
This translation has not been reviewed by a native Hungarian speaker.
